name: Site Screenshots
description: Takes the screenshots of the cthangover.ru site from the main game: the prologue dialog, several locations with their scenarios, the inventory, character, map, journal and skills panels, and a card battle in front of the town entry. Activated by --itest=site_shots with --game=cthangover --new and --shots=<dir> (windowed runs only); the language comes from the player's settings.
